title: Photocatalytic abatement of ambient NOx by TiO2 coated solar panels
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,963-972
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00516C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jesse Molar, Pierre Herckes, Matthew P. Fraser
TiO2-based photocatalytic coatings applied to glass substrates, such as solar panels, demonstrated the ability to reduce NOx concentrations by up to 36% in laboratory settings and generate nitrate flux values of up to 33 mg per m2 per day in field tests.
